title: Fixed coordinates of the final tensor and pullback-square transport
statement: With finite-field and coefficient data D,C,E,n >= 1, a six-functor datum S [def-sf-operation-stages], compactified Cartesian square Q, bounded constructible K on X and finite-Tor constructible L on Y, put M=K tensor f-star L [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates]. Let d be the inverse tensor realization followed by tensoring the fixed f pullback realization of L. Let mid be supportRealization on g-prime-star M followed by the realized f-prime-support image of fixedPullRealization for g-prime composed with derived g-prime pullback of d. The intrinsic image of f-prime-support applied to Mu for g-prime followed by tensoring the restricted pull-square comparison, postcomposed with SquareTarget [def-sf-finite-base-change-realization-paths], equals mid followed by realization of fixed f-prime-support of the canonical fixed target map (fixed tensor monoidality followed by tensoring inverse square comparison). This equation has no projection component or exchange map.

proof.text: Use naturality of supportRealization to move the final tensor transport into fixed support coordinates. Expand the prescribed Mu. Cancel its inverse fixed-pull comparisons against the tensor comparisons in SquareTarget; move the equivalence-unit comparison through the tensor map by unit naturality.

Write r_h for fixedPullRealization along h and tau for the restricted square transport. Apply finitePullCompositionNormalization for (g-prime,f) and (f-prime,g), and transport their common composite-map realization along Q.squareComm. Cancelling that realization identifies tau followed by r_f-prime at g-star L and f-prime-star of r_g with r_g-prime at f-star L followed by g-prime-star of r_f and then the inverse canonical derived square comparison. Tensor this equality with the fixed first input. Naturality of fixed tensor monoidality in its second input moves r_f through it. Functoriality now gives the fixed target map under support. The same identities cover zero objects, identity maps and empty schemes, without finite Tor on K.

theorem sixFunctorProjectionFinite_left_tensor_transport
    (S : SixFunctorDatum D C E n hn) (Q : SixFunctorCompactifiedSquare D)
    (K : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E n hn Q.X)
    (L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory C.l E n hn Q.Y.obj.left) :
    letI := Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n hn
    let A := ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n)
    let RX := realization (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) Q.X
    let RY := realization (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) Q.Y
    let R' := realization (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) Q.Y'
    let TX := fixedTensor (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) Q.X
    let U := fixedDerivedPull (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) Q.g'
    let F := sfFixedCompactSupport (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n)
      (Q.compactification.ofIsPullback Q.square)
    let I := (intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible C.l E n hn Q.Y'.obj.left).ι
    let M := ((partialTensor S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations Q.X).obj K).obj
      ((torPull S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations Q.f).obj L)
    let d := sixFunctorProjectionFiniteTensorRealization S Q.X K
        ((torPull S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations Q.f).obj L) ≪≫
      (TX.obj (RX.inverse.obj K.obj)).mapIso
        (fixedPullRealization S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations Q.f ⟨L.obj, L.property.1⟩)
    let mid := supportRealization S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations Q.f'
        (Q.compactification.ofIsPullback Q.square) ((S.finite.pull Q.g').obj M) ≪≫
      R'.functor.mapIso (F.mapIso
        (fixedPullRealization S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations Q.g' M ≪≫ U.mapIso d))
    I.map ((S.finite.support Q.f' (Q.compactification.ofIsPullback Q.square)).map
      ((sixFunctorProjectionFiniteMu S Q.g' K
          ((torPull S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations Q.f).obj L)).hom ≫
        ((partialTensor S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations Q.X').obj
          ((S.finite.pull Q.g').obj K)).map
          ((torPullComposition S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations Q.g' Q.f L).inv ≫
            ObjectProperty.homMk (eqToHom (congrArg
              (fun f ↦ ((torPull S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations f).obj L).obj)
              Q.squareComm)) ≫
            (torPullComposition S.toSixFunctorFiniteOperations Q.f' Q.g L).hom))) ≫
      (sixFunctorProjectionFiniteSquareTarget S Q K L).hom =
    mid.hom ≫ R'.functor.map (F.map
      (FiniteProjectionExchange.target A Q.square (RX.inverse.obj K.obj)
        (RY.inverse.obj L.obj)))
